items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 18:1
items.html: (To the question) The discussion is only about the matter of both of them using a single Keter, namely that they be in a coupling in an equal stature up to the Keter. However, in back to back, even though the Nukva ascends with ZA into a single Keter, as on Yom Kippur at Neila, nevertheless there is no coupling between them then; therefore it is not included in this degree.
